title: WP-UAT-D: badf-uat representative shadow — every G10 control driven, with tripwires that expire by themselves
objective: Complete rung D of badf-uat's A->E ladder on a DECLARED REPRESENTATIVE corpus, per SARCHI's amended ruling on #277, and make the representativeness caveat expire mechanically rather than by anyone remembering it.
business_value: A capability admitted without ever being observed working is law without evidence. BADF has no product-acceptance event of its own, so the alternative to a declared representative shadow is either a vacuous one (zero discrimination) or a ladder documented as uncompletable for every product-side family.
in_scope: examples/uat-shadow-checkout.json + .log: a representative accepted run for PRD-SHADOW-CHECKOUT
examples/uat-shadow-checkout-rejected.json: a critical FAIL with a classified defect and RECOMMEND_REJECT, ADMITTED
skills/badf-uat/references/shadow-evidence.md: caveat in the FIRST section, #166 form, declared non-coverage
tests/test_badf_uat_shadow.py: all 11 controls driven with observed red, recomputed not stored, two tripwires
out_of_scope: Any change to check_g10_uat_binding -- D observes the controls, it does not alter them
#289's substring fix: a different surface (badf_gate.py), filed rather than folded
Registry advance to APPROVED/ACTIVE -- rung E is an operator admission, not this rung
Real scenario derivation, execution adapters, defect triage -- declared non-coverage, deferred to #291
acceptance_criteria: Every ValidationError site in check_g10_uat_binding has a shadow case, asserted by AST against the LIVE gate rather than a written number
Each case observed RED against its OWN message fragment, not merely a non-zero raise
The rejecting run is ADMITTED -- the gate refuses malformed evidence, never an unfavourable result
test_no_real_g10_dossier_exists_yet goes RED when a real G10 dossier is planted (verified)
test_the_known_substring_hole_in_c7_c9_is_still_open goes RED when #289's fix is applied (verified)
The shadow doc names #277, #289, #291 and states the caveat in its first section
Every defect_class in the schema enum is injected and admitted, the enum read from the schema rather than written in the test, with an unknown class refused as the negative control
acceptance_basis.traceability_digest is populated in the corpus and pinned, so the PRD/AC/RTM chain the rung-A ladder asks for is carried
One adversarial case beyond the ten that NO control catches, asserted ADMITTED and asserted DECLARED in shadow-evidence.md -- the search for one found four, and all four are declared
Registry advances IMPLEMENTED -> SHADOWED in one edit, with BOTH earned steps declared: VALIDATED earned at rung C and omitted (#268's class), SHADOWED earned by D
acceptance.md amended EXTEND-ONLY: the frozen D bullet is unchanged; the amendment records what D delivers, what defers to #291, and the standing rung-status co-edit rule
GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md carries a WP-UAT-D section in the established per-rung form, as every prior badf-uat rung and both precedent D rungs do

test_obligations.claim: every G10 control refuses its own defect, all ten defect classes are injected from the schema enum, and the corpus carries the PRD/AC/RTM chain
both tripwires fire when their claim stops being true -- a real G10 dossier appearing, and #289's hole closing

evidence: mutation on each control and both tripwires
note: Lean mode ADVISORY. The empty-corpus alternative was mine and was the weaker instrument wearing the honest label; the vacuity/realism distinction is recorded in the shadow doc because it is the reusable part, not the corpus.
